gate_legend.G1: Input: the observation file and candidate configuration passed validation.
gate_legend.G2: Liveness at the time of observation: "stop" = both the employer feed and the page say it is gone (skip); "review" = the feed and the page disagree, or the page is uncertain / shows closure wording (a person checks). Never "open now".
gate_legend.G3: Sponsorship and eligibility wording in THIS posting: "stop" = an explicit refusal or an explicit citizenship requirement (skip). Clearance/export-control wording goes to a person. Company history is never used here.
gate_legend.G4: Experience and degree: "stop" = a documented mismatch with a stated required minimum, or an explicit eligibility restriction (experience cap, graduation window). "review" = ranges exceeded, either/or branches, unclear co-op counting, unlabeled sections. "pass-unknown" = nothing stated. A mismatch is not a claim the employer could never make an exception.
gate_legend.G5: Start window by date arithmetic only: "stop" = an explicit employer start window that ends before the supplied availability date. "review" = ASAP, offer-relative, ambiguous, or conflicting timing. "pass-unknown" = no timing stated. Never establishes work authorization, EAD approval, or hiring duration.
gate_legend.G6: Stack evidence: "pass" = a JVM language in required or responsibility lines plus backend-infrastructure terms. "review" = Java only in preferred/other lines, another language required, or too little text. Evidence locations, not a score.
gate_legend.G7: Sponsorship evidence for this opening: "pass" = apparent offer wording for a person to read (not a guarantee); otherwise "stop" = awaiting opening-level evidence.
gate_legend.G8: Final review: always a person. Nothing is applied to automatically.
